title: The customFds option of child_process has been removed
summary: Node.js removed the customFds option of child_process (DEP0006: documentation-only since v0.5.10, runtime deprecation since v0.11.14, end-of-life since v12.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the customFds option of child_process with options.stdio.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
